The Outfield were an English pop rock band from the East End of London, formed in 1984.
The band achieved success in the mid-1980s and are best remembered for their hit single "Your Love".
The band's lineup consisted of guitarist John Spinks, vocalist and bassist Tony Lewis, and drummer Alan Jackman.
